parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Design intent (SYS-02 to SYS-05): V-001 separates production fluid by density into three streams at nominal 60 psig/130 °F: gas to fuel gas with excess to the burn pit, oil to the Heater–Treater and then V-003, and free water to water treatment. All six source elements (SYS-07) were examined with the applicable SYS-08 guidewords across the inlet, the gas, oil and water outlets, relief, instrumentation and E-001. Only SYS-06 items are credited as safeguards. Their functions and locations are inferred from tag conventions and remain unconfirmed. The packet lists no independent level/interface or temperature alarms or trips, check valves, burn-pit flashback protection, fire and gas detection or corrosion programme. Highest priorities are: loss of liquid seal causing gas blowby to downstream equipment; overpressure from gas-outlet blockage or PV-101 failure, judged against an unresolved design-pressure/PSV basis; high level causing liquid carryover to fuel gas and burn pit; the source-supported start-up-without-bypass error; and fire/explosion escalation. Low inlet flow is mainly an operational deviation but can escalate to gas blowby, burn-pit flashback or E-001 over-temperature. Risk classes are qualitative judgments for prioritisation only. No organizational findings are made because no organizational facts were supplied.

Hydrate, wax and sand-specific scenarios: unresolved; referenced conditionally only because no fluid or solids data were supplied.
Reverse flow from the fuel gas system: unresolved; no alternative fuel gas supply sources are stated.
Upstream overpressure of production lines on inlet isolation: outside the Node 1 boundary; refer to the upstream node.
Internal hazards of the Heater–Treater, water treatment and V-003: outside the Node 1 boundary; only interface consequences are recorded.
PSV-101 A/B set pressure, sizing basis and discharge destination: unresolved.
Service/location of LV-101, LV-102, SDV-30010, SDV-101, SDV-102, FIT-101 and FAL-103: unresolved; functions inferred from tag conventions only.
Identity of the bypass in the SYS-09 start-up item and its documented consequence: unresolved.
